organism.aristotelian_path: IV. Protista & Monera -> Mineralized Protists (Silica/Calcite) -> Ammonia

phenomenon_scale.label: 31 µm
phenomenon_scale.anatomical_reading: Selected pustule / pore-cluster spacing on the chamber face. Not a pigment ocellus and not the pore diameter.

scale_contrast.pore_diameter_source: Subba & Ghosh 2023, Ammonia cf. beccarii, mean of 100 pores on 4 tests (doi:10.2113/gsjfr.53.2.177)
scale_contrast.derived_spacing_note: 1/sqrt(pore density); derived here, not a tabulated spacing in the source
scale_contrast.petersen_note: 562 µm² measurement window on the penultimate chamber (doi:10.1016/j.marmicro.2016.08.001). Side length 23.7 µm is adjacent to this tier and is not λ_c.

schoenfeld_2021_living_mean_diameter_um.note: A. beccarii itself was absent from the living fauna and present only in the dead assemblage (doi:10.5194/jm-40-195-2021)

scale_contrast.what_changes: Chronoseries 1/1 has no other age. At 0 Ma the extant test carries three nested lengths. The pore mode (0.564 µm) and the whole-test mode (~600 µm) lie outside the Turing band. This slot selects the intermediate wavenumber k_c = 2π/31.37 µm⁻¹. Relative to the pore mode the wavelength lengthens ~56×; relative to a single test-scale patch it shortens ~19×. That is the change at this scale. It is not a parameter copied from any other chronospecies slot.

equations.kinetics: Schnakenberg (1979): f = a - u + u^2 v, g = b - u^2 v
equations.pde: u_t = Du ∇²u + γ f(u,v); v_t = Dv ∇²v + γ g(u,v)
equations.dispersion: σ solves det(γ J - k^2 D - σ I) = 0
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = γ (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)
turing_conditions: (Dv f_u + Du g_v)^2 > 4 Du Dv det(J)
equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic square of side L = 600 µm, the Hillewaert caption diameter, standing in for one adult test face.

parameters.gamma_note: γ is solved so the linear λ_c equals 31.37 µm exactly
parameters.why_these_values: a and b sum to 1 so u0 = 1. Dv/Du = 10.4 sits just above the Turing threshold for this Jacobian (margin ≈ 1.15), which keeps the unstable band near 27–39 µm instead of letting spots coarsen onto a test-scale patch. These numbers are not the 27 µm Globorotalia slot.

specimen_image.gallery_fallback_rejected: datasets/species_gallery/IV_Protista_Monera_Mycota/Ammonia_beccarii.jpg is a Caryophyllia coral photograph, not Ammonia.
